### Fixed
- **muster-crds accepts any CRD annotation, and CI runs its chart tests.** The loader merges every key of `crds.annotations` into each CRD, but the generated `values.schema.json` admitted only `helm.sh/resource-policy`, so any other annotation failed the install with `additional properties ... not allowed`. The schema now takes any key with a string value and refuses a non-string one, which the API server would reject. `make helm-unittest` (the `chart-test` job) ran the muster chart's suites only; it now runs the muster-crds suite as well, updated to the three CRDs the chart ships and the current Workflow CEL rules. `NOTES.txt` and `UPGRADE.md` name the `WorkflowExecution` CRD too. ([#1324](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1324))
